notes: Coverage combines explicit immutable source receipts. Later supplied results supersede earlier ones by case ID. Source differences remain listed; this is not a claim that every historical case was rerun on one final snapshot.

Forward/reference visual limits remain mean<=1.5/255 and perceptibly changed pixel share<=.01. Same-history reverse discrepancy is bounded against reference with allowances mean .06/share .0001; exact PNG status is separate from strict DOM and native clock checks.
No compositor case exceptions were needed. Restoring the original cream backplate fixed the square viewport edge discrepancy.

The supplied-image ui-float branch has a documented frozen-engine insertion failure; the native branch passes explicit decoded-image/visible-geometry/pixel-color checks. Explicit dial timing is new native behavior, checked against requested beats rather than the old default schedule.

Without a frozen reference, the native CI smoke uses the retained picture-audit reverse criterion: resize to quarter width/height with the cubic kernel, then at most .0002 of pixels may differ by more than 96 in a channel. Full-size differences remain diagnostic; DOM, geometry, and clocks remain strict.

After all checks, eight blank-line tabs were removed. The embedded formatting proof verifies every before/after SHA256 and exact blank-line-only transformation against the CI source copy; no executable or string content changed.
